title: OG Circle
description: Every existing public Open Source Orchestra node, with origin and legend lineage from the already-public node pages.
disclaimer: This is a public-source lineage directory, not a DAO membership, participation, endorsement, or consent list. Inclusion does not imply that any person or collective has joined, approved, or endorsed the Open Source Orchestra DAO.

source.scope: Existing public node.json and index.html fields only, plus existing public Garden Circle media and the public facts pack.

circle_image.alt: A full circle: musicians in the middle, and listeners on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, between glowing neon pyramids.
circle_image.credit: Official Devcon 8 photos by the Devcon team's photographers.

image_policy: Card images are existing public node media thumbnails or Garden Circle assets. Thumbnails and logos retain their original context and are not new consent or endorsement signals. Where image is null, render emoji as a monogram; do not substitute a guessed portrait.

nodes.name: Matteo Tambussi
nodes.headline: The brother who asked first
nodes.lineage: Origin · the 2022 live, community-run open-mic music-stage proposal
nodes.tagline: CO-FOUNDER OF THE TRADITION · musician & linguist · Turin, Italy
nodes.bio: Musician, producer and political linguist from Turin; co-founder of SpaghettETH. His live, community-run open-mic music-stage proposal for Devcon Bogotá, submitted on 17 June 2022, seeded the Open Source Orchestra Music Space. Devcon's wider music history includes the earlier 2020 Audius music DIP.

nodes.name: Justin Myles Holmes
nodes.headline: Blockchains are bluegrass
nodes.lineage: Legend · cryptograss and the Immutable String Band
nodes.tagline: CRYPTOGRASS · and the Immutable String Band · Ashland, Oregon
nodes.bio: Leader of Justin Holmes and the Immutable String Band and namer of cryptograss: bluegrass and blockchains as traditions of preserving and remixing music outside the IP system. His releases carry CC BY-SA.

image.alt: Justin Holmes — Vowel Sounds live at ETHBarcelona

nodes.name: Shaka Lei Kaumaka
nodes.headline: The bard who opened the circle
nodes.tagline: THE ETHEREUM BARD · conductor & co-founder of the Open Source Orchestra
nodes.bio: Musician on guitar, ukulele and voice; founder and human steward of the Open Source Orchestra. A touring musician turned Ethereum bard, and keeper of the AI ʻohana that builds with him.

nodes.name: Manu Alzuru
nodes.headline: El Cuatro — four on the floor, or so much more
nodes.tagline: THE LOVEPUNK · DJ & community architect · El Cuatro of the orchestra
nodes.bio: Humanist, engineer, DJ, producer and community architect. Founder of ETHBarcelona, DoinGud, Blockravers and Lovepunks.xyz; his sets move through Latin, Afro, tribal, organic and melodic house and techno.

image.alt: The Rise of Trust Networks — Manu Alzuru, Blockravers, ETHDenver

nodes.name: Jake Hartnell
nodes.headline: THE POWER 5TH — the trust weaver
nodes.lineage: Builder · trustgraphs and the Circle of Trust
nodes.tagline: THE POWER 5TH · the trust weaver · builder of trustgraphs
nodes.bio: Builder of trustgraphs and co-founder of Stargaze, Juno, DAO DAO and Layer. His public node traces vouch → score → prove → use and the orchestra's Circle of Trust.

image.alt: Jake Hartnell at DEVMOS 2024 — Extending DAO DAO to Create Bespoke Governance Processes

nodes.name: Alaska
nodes.headline: THE MASTER SIX — the man with the sax
nodes.lineage: Steward · sax, selection and a welcome for every human
nodes.tagline: THE MASTER SIX · the man with the sax · steward of the Music Space
nodes.bio: Saxophonist and selector, and a steward of the Devcon 8 Music Space. His call to welcome general humanity beyond Web3 inspired the orchestra's public Definition Button.

image.kind: Garden Circle logo; not a portrait

nodes.name: Jonathan Mann
nodes.headline: THE SONG A DAY MAN — 7 days a week
nodes.lineage: Legend · a song every day since 1 January 2009
nodes.tagline: THE SONG A DAY MAN · 7 days a week, every week, since January 1, 2009
nodes.bio: Writer of Song A Day since 1 January 2009, with a Creative Commons catalog stewarded by SongADAO. His Ethereum history includes Devcon 4 in Prague and Devcon 6 in Bogotá.

image.alt: Merge Song — Devcon 6 Opening Ceremonies, Ethereum Foundation

nodes.name: LATASHÁ
nodes.headline: THE OCTAVE — the return home
nodes.lineage: Legend · onchain music and artist community
nodes.tagline: THE OCTAVE · onchain music pioneer · founder of Zoratopia & Topia
nodes.bio: Brooklyn-raised rapper, poet, visual and performance artist. An early onchain music pioneer on Zora, founder of Zoratopia and builder of Topia.

nodes.name: Imogen Heap
nodes.headline: THE NINE — the godmother completes the circle she began
nodes.lineage: Origin and legend · Tiny Human, Mycelia and The Creative Passport
nodes.tagline: THE NINE · the godmother of onchain music · Mycelia · Auracles
nodes.bio: Artist, engineer and inventor whose 2015 Tiny Human/Ujo Music experiment preceded Mycelia and The Creative Passport, now Auracles. Creator of the MI.MU gloves and the consent-first AI twin ai.Mogen.

image.alt: Imogen Heap — Hide And Seek official video

nodes.name: Santiago Reos
nodes.headline: THE ROOT REBORN — the second circle begins on Do
nodes.lineage: Second circle · Dúo Dø guitarra y palmas
nodes.tagline: guitarra y palmas · one half of Dúo Dø デュオ・ドー · Buenos Aires → Japan
nodes.bio: Guitarist, composer, producer and educator from Buenos Aires; one half of Dúo Dø, weaving Argentine roots with Japan. His node also records the SongCamp Challenge Latam and Devconnect Argentina connection.

image.alt: Dúo Dø - デュオ・ドー — the duo's own presentation film

nodes.name: Clementine Esquivel
nodes.headline: THE PAIR — two ones, side by side
nodes.lineage: Second circle · Dúo Dø voz, palmas, percu y bombo
nodes.tagline: voz, palmas, percu y bombo · one half of Dúo Dø デュオ・ドー · Buenos Aires → Japan
nodes.bio: Singer, percussionist, composer, producer and educator from Buenos Aires; one half of Dúo Dø. Her record credit is ‘Voz, palmas, percu y bombo.’

image.alt: Mi Amor Por Ti ft Matt Lee — Dúo Dø, the Kismet Casa film

nodes.name: Tomo
nodes.headline: THE CHROMATIC SCALE COMPLETE — the inward-circle visionary
nodes.lineage: Origin · the Infinite Garden and the inward-facing circle
nodes.tagline: the inward-circle visionary · Devcon team · designer of the Infinite Garden's world
nodes.bio: Publicly known as Tomo Saito, an Ethereum Foundation designer creating the world of the Infinite Garden. His node honors the inward-facing music circle: voices answering one another.

image.alt: Ethereum Culture Expanding in the Infinite Garden by Tomo Saito — Devcon SEA

nodes.name: MUSICA W3
nodes.headline: THE FIRST COLLECTIVE CHAIR — 150 artists, one voice
nodes.lineage: Collective · creator sovereignty, education and monthly drops
nodes.tagline: comunidad internacional de artistas independientes · born from Argentina · 150+ artistas, one voice
nodes.bio: An international community and social club for independent artists, born from Argentina: 150+ artists and 2k+ collectors, monthly collective drops, WOW! Festival and free creator-sovereignty education.

links.label: Curso: Hacia la Soberanía de los Creadores Onchain

nodes.name: Inch Chua
nodes.headline: THE FREEHAND CIRCLE — the first Singapore chair
nodes.lineage: Second circle · folktronica, open distribution and the freehand circle
nodes.tagline: the freehand circle · folktronica pioneer · Singapore's DIY first voice
nodes.bio: Singaporean singer-songwriter, producer and multidisciplinary artist. The Bedroom EP (2009) was free/pay-what-you-want; her TEDxSingapore story celebrates the circle drawn freehand.

image.alt: TEDxSingapore — Inch Chua — [ i ]nch by inch

nodes.name: IX Shells
nodes.headline: THE CARIBBEAN GLITCH — the first Panama chair
nodes.lineage: Second circle · code as canvas, code as song
nodes.tagline: the Caribbean glitch · code as canvas, code as song · the Tor Project's 500-ETH artist
nodes.bio: Itzel Yard, an Afro-Panamanian generative artist and self-taught coder working across sound and code. Dreaming at Dusk (2021), her collaboration with The Tor Project, supports privacy and the open web.
